prediction: ∀ (a : Point) (b : Point) (e : Point) (c : Point) (d : Point) (f : Point) (AB : Line) (EF : Line) (CD : Line), ((distinctPointsOnLine a b AB) ∧ (distinctPointsOnLine c d CD) ∧ (e.onLine AB) ∧ (e.onLine EF) ∧ (f.onLine CD) ∧ (f.onLine EF) ∧ (∠ a:e:f = ∠ c:f:e)) → (¬(AB.intersectsLine CD))
groud_truth: ∀ (a d e f : Point) (AE FD EF : Line), distinctPointsOnLine a e AE ∧ distinctPointsOnLine f d FD ∧ distinctPointsOnLine e f EF ∧ a.opposingSides d EF ∧ (∠ a:e:f = ∠ e:f:d) → ¬(AE.intersectsLine FD)
